title: Maximal Rectangle
goal: Solve Maximal Rectangle: Turn each matrix row into consecutive vertical heights and solve a largest-rectangle histogram for that row.
strategy: Turn each matrix row into consecutive vertical heights and solve a largest-rectangle histogram for that row.
edgeCases: A zero resets its column height; rectangles may start in earlier rows but must remain all ones.
inputRules: Enter a non-empty rectangular JSON matrix containing only 0 or 1.
